BuildInfoView.description: Immutable identity shared by the app bundle and local backend.
BuildInfoView.title: BuildInfoView

CreateBranchRequest.description:
Discriminated human expansion command.

A direction is free text.  A revision is direct human-authored scientific
content, so its instruction must be a JSON object with exactly the five
StepContent fields.  A runtime must canonicalize it before recording the
revise_step HumanAction; it must never ask a model to author content and
label that output as human.
CreateBranchRequest.title: CreateBranchRequest

CreateRunDefaultsView.description: Server-owned defaults for the product's create-run form.
CreateRunDefaultsView.title: CreateRunDefaultsView

ExportReportRequest.description: Select and explicitly confirm the main route for one immutable export.
ExportReportRequest.title: ExportReportRequest

FinalizeIntakeSessionRequest.description:
Start with what is known: answer any pending problem question and go.

Valid only while the session is ``convergence_required``. Every pending
problem question must be answered; everything still open becomes a declared
default the derivation agent owns.
FinalizeIntakeSessionRequest.title: FinalizeIntakeSessionRequest

FrozenProblemInput.description: Versioned scientific input; direct input and Intake confirmation have distinct provenance.
FrozenProblemInput.title: FrozenProblemInput

FrozenRunConfig.description: Fields that map exactly into Record V1 run_created payloads.
FrozenRunConfig.title: FrozenRunConfig

IntakeAnswerInput.description:
One answer: chosen options, free text, or a ladder strategy.

``simplest_first`` and ``both_routes`` are answers in their own right, so an
input carrying only a strategy is complete. ``both_routes`` without an
explicit selection means every option the question offered.
IntakeAnswerInput.title: IntakeAnswerInput

IntakeConvergenceView.description: Server-side budget that decides when the grill stops asking.
IntakeConvergenceView.title: IntakeConvergenceView

IntakeDeclaredDefaultView.description: A convention or approximation the agent adopts instead of asking.
IntakeDeclaredDefaultView.title: IntakeDeclaredDefaultView

IntakeLadderRungView.description: One refinement level; rung 0 is the textbook-simplest baseline.
IntakeLadderRungView.title: IntakeLadderRungView

IntakePendingAnswerView.description: One answer as the user submitted it, before any round accepted it.
IntakePendingAnswerView.title: IntakePendingAnswerView

IntakePendingSubmissionView.description:
What the user submitted on an attempt that never reached a commit.

A round writes the user's answers and the model's reply together, so a model
round that fails takes the answers with it. The server keeps them here so
the client can offer them back instead of making the user retype them.
IntakePendingSubmissionView.title: IntakePendingSubmissionView

IntakeQuestionView.description: One problem-class decision the user must settle before the derivation runs.
IntakeQuestionView.title: IntakeQuestionView

ModelOptionView.description: One App Server model and its model-specific reasoning levels.
ModelOptionView.title: ModelOptionView

ReportBundleView.title: ReportBundleView

RunCommandCapabilities.description: Backend-derived mutation affordances for one concrete Run snapshot.
RunCommandCapabilities.title: RunCommandCapabilities

RunSummary.description: Small catalog row for active and immutable archived runs.
RunSummary.title: RunSummary

RunView.description:
Canonical complete snapshot plus backend-derived control phase.

A real service must build this from the last strict-replayable Record V1
head.  In-flight deltas belong only in ``RunEvent.overlay`` and must not be
promoted into ``steps`` before a StepRevision is sealed.

``typeset_layers`` is the one place where this snapshot is not the sealed
text: the routes listed there have their math fragments rendered from a
verified typeset layer, and the steps carrying that text say so with
``StepView.typeset``.
RunView.title: RunView

RuntimeConfig.description:
Implemented v1 execution profile stored outside frozen Record config.

V1 exposes ChatGPT subscription authentication, the serial scheduler, and
one versioned benchmark capability profile. ``max_run_seconds`` remains an
explicit required null until the service enforces a wall-clock deadline.
RuntimeConfig.title: RuntimeConfig

SiteLoginRequest.description: Website login input; password whitespace is never silently normalized.
SiteLoginRequest.title: SiteLoginRequest

SitePasswordChangeRequest.description: Password rotation input; exact bytes are passed to the identity authority.
SitePasswordChangeRequest.title: SitePasswordChangeRequest

SourcePackRef.description: Opaque reference-pack identity; no retrieval authority is implied.
SourcePackRef.title: SourcePackRef

StepView.description:
One sealed StepRevision as the product shows it.

``output_sha256`` always identifies the *recorded* content, even when
``typeset`` is true: the sealed text is the Record, and a typeset layer is
a display artifact derived from it, never a new version of it.
StepView.title: StepView

TypesetLayerView.description:
Identity of the typeset layer one route's shown text was taken from.

``content_sha256`` is the layer's own content hash, so a client can tell
two renderings of the same Record apart, and ``status`` is the layer's
compile verdict (a layer delivered with failures still repairs the
formulas it could).
TypesetLayerView.title: TypesetLayerView
